metadata.title: Healthcare Revenue Bonds: Credit Drivers Dataset
metadata.author: Muni-Pal Research: Sub-Agent 6
metadata.notes: Structured dataset of 5-8 key credit drivers per sub-sector; includes scoring weights and benchmark ranges.

credit_drivers.name: Payor Mix
credit_drivers.description: Distribution of patient revenues by type (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial, self-pay)
credit_drivers.data_source: SEC prospectus, operating statements

credit_drivers.name: Occupancy Rate
credit_drivers.description: Percent of licensed beds in use (hospital census / licensed beds)
credit_drivers.data_source: Hospital operating statistics, annual financial statements

credit_drivers.name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)
credit_drivers.description: Net operating revenues / (Principal + Interest expense); primary credit metric
credit_drivers.data_source: Audited financial statements, rating agency reports

credit_drivers.name: Operating Margin (Adjusted)
credit_drivers.description: Operating income / Net patient revenues (excluding non-operating gains)
red_flags: Margin compression due to labor costs
credit_drivers.data_source: Audited financial statements, operating margins

credit_drivers.name: Days Cash on Hand
credit_drivers.description: Liquid cash reserves / daily operating expenses
credit_drivers.data_source: Balance sheet, statement of cash flows

credit_drivers.name: Debt-to-Capitalization Ratio
credit_drivers.description: Total debt / (Total debt + Unrestricted net assets)
credit_drivers.note: Healthcare-specific: excludes restricted assets (endowments, donor-restricted funds)
red_flags: Refinancing stress due to high leverage
credit_drivers.data_source: Balance sheet, capital structure analysis

credit_drivers.name: Case Mix Index (CMI)
credit_drivers.description: Weighted average of diagnosis-related group (DRG) codes; indicates clinical complexity
credit_drivers.context: Varies by region (academic medical centers naturally higher); peer comparison essential
credit_drivers.data_source: Hospital discharge data, Medicare CMS

conduit_501c3_issuance.note: Two-layer credit assessment: (1) Operator credit, (2) Conduit structure credit

credit_drivers.name: Operator Financial Performance
credit_drivers.description: Net revenues, operating margin, DSCR (same framework as hospital bonds)
credit_drivers.data_source: Operator audited statements, bond offering documents

credit_drivers.name: Operator Market Position
credit_drivers.description: Market share in service area, referral patterns, competitive positioning
credit_drivers.data_source: Market studies, payer contracts, competitive analysis

credit_drivers.name: Operator Leverage & Capital Structure
credit_drivers.description: Existing debt burden, debt service obligations (all debt), refinancing risk
credit_drivers.data_source: Debt schedule, capital structure memo

credit_drivers.name: Conduit Issuer Credit
credit_drivers.description: State/local issuer creditworthiness, historical default experience, budget health
credit_drivers.data_source: Issuer credit rating, audited general fund statements

credit_drivers.name: Security/Reserve Package
credit_drivers.description: Debt service reserve fund sizing, operating reserve, intercreditor arrangements
credit_drivers.data_source: Loan agreement, trust indenture

credit_drivers.name: Loan Agreement / Operating Covenants
credit_drivers.description: Strength of loan agreement, management fees, merger/sale restrictions
credit_drivers.data_source: Loan agreement, operating covenants section

ccrc_revenue_bonds.note: Entrance fee + monthly service fee model; unique refund liability exposure

credit_drivers.name: Occupancy Rate by Service Level
credit_drivers.description: Percent of units occupied (independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing)
credit_drivers.data_source: Occupancy reports, census tracking

credit_drivers.name: Entrance Fee Model & Sustainability
credit_drivers.description: Type and amount of entrance fees; percent of revenue from entrance fees vs. monthly fees

entrance_fee_types.type_a: Fully Refundable (100% refund) - High liability, low revenue certainty
entrance_fee_types.type_b: Modified (Partial refund, e.g., 80% first year, declining) - Moderate balance
entrance_fee_types.type_c: Non-Refundable (No refund) - Highest revenue certainty, potentially less attractive
entrance_fee_types.type_d: Declining Balance (e.g., 95%, 90%, 85%...) - Common for strong operators

optimal_benchmarks.fee_model: Type B or D (modified or declining)

red_flags: Entrance fee refund liability > 120% of reserves
Type A (fully refundable) with declining occupancy
credit_drivers.data_source: Prospectus, entrance fee policy, balance sheet

credit_drivers.name: Monthly Revenue Stability & Rate Increase History
credit_drivers.description: Resident fee inflation history; ability to raise rates without resident turnover
red_flags: Market occupancy decline limiting pricing power
credit_drivers.data_source: Rate history, management discussion of pricing

credit_drivers.name: Days Cash on Hand (Excluding Refund Reserve)
credit_drivers.description: Liquid cash / daily operating expenses (separate operational from refund reserve liquidity)
credit_drivers.ccrc_specific_risk: Must maintain BOTH operational reserve AND entrance fee reserve; undercounting either = crisis
credit_drivers.data_source: Balance sheet, statement of cash flows, entrance fee reserve accounting

credit_drivers.name: DSCR (Net of Refund Expense)
credit_drivers.description: Calculation: (Operating Revenues - Refund Expense) / Debt Service
credit_drivers.note: Accounting treatment of entrance fees varies (some recognize upfront, others amortize); verify calculation
credit_drivers.data_source: Audited financial statements, DSCR calculation

credit_drivers.name: Average Resident Age & Acuity Mix
credit_drivers.description: Average age of residents; proportion in each service level (independent, assisted, skilled)

implications.higher_age_acuity: Shorter lifespan; faster fee turnover; more new admission costs; higher refund volatility
implications.younger_cohort: Longer residency; more stable revenues; lower healthcare costs

credit_drivers.covid_impact: COVID mortality (2020-2021) disrupted many CCRC models; recovery varies by region
credit_drivers.data_source: Census data, resident demographics

credit_drivers.name: Waiting List & Application Pipeline
credit_drivers.description: Length of waiting list for independent living units; new application rate
credit_drivers.data_source: Marketing data, admissions pipeline

senior_living_non_ccrc.note: Monthly rental model; Medicaid-dependent; no entrance fees

credit_drivers.name: Occupancy Rate
credit_drivers.description: Percent of available units occupied
red_flags: Specific unit type or memory care struggling
credit_drivers.data_source: Occupancy reports, census tracking

credit_drivers.name: Payor Mix (Medicaid vs. Private Pay)
credit_drivers.description: Percent of residents on Medicaid vs. private pay vs. hybrid models

state_medicaid_variation.low_rate_states: Southern states with low rates and pressure

credit_drivers.trend: States cutting rates → Senior living operators under pressure
red_flags: State Medicaid rate freeze or cuts
credit_drivers.data_source: Payor source data, operating statements

credit_drivers.name: Pricing Power & Rate Increase History
credit_drivers.description: Ability to increase monthly rents without vacancy spike

optimal_benchmarks.weak: Flat rents or declining (0% or negative)

red_flags: Resident turnover spike after rate increase
credit_drivers.data_source: Rate history, management discussion, marketing data

credit_drivers.name: Days Cash on Hand
credit_drivers.description: Liquid reserves / daily operating expenses
credit_drivers.data_source: Balance sheet, statement of cash flows

credit_drivers.name: Debt-to-Capitalization Ratio
credit_drivers.description: Total debt / (Total debt + Net assets)
credit_drivers.data_source: Balance sheet, capital structure

credit_drivers.name: Management Quality & Operator Track Record
credit_drivers.description: Operator's history of stability, turnover, litigation

optimal_benchmarks.excellent: Multi-facility operator with 10+ year track record

credit_drivers.data_source: Operator background check, historical performance, regulatory records

behavioral_health_facilities.note: Census-driven (patient days); highly concentrated payor; regulatory licensing risk

credit_drivers.name: Payor Concentration
credit_drivers.description: % of revenue from Medicaid vs. commercial vs. self-pay

state_variation.strong_markets: TX, FL, CA (stronger private/commercial payor mix)

credit_drivers.data_source: Operating statements, payor source data

credit_drivers.name: Average Length of Stay (ALOS) & Occupancy
credit_drivers.description: Average days per patient; percent of licensed beds in use
credit_drivers.data_source: Census reports, discharge data, occupancy tracking

credit_drivers.name: Medicaid Reimbursement Rate Trends
credit_drivers.description: State Medicaid daily rate; trend (increasing, flat, declining)
credit_drivers.monitoring: State legislative budget cycles; healthcare commissioner statements
credit_drivers.data_source: State Medicaid agency, rate schedule, budget forecasts

credit_drivers.name: DSCR & Debt Service Coverage
credit_drivers.description: Operating revenues (patient days × rate) / Debt service

optimal_benchmarks.strong: >1.35x (behavioral health higher risk; higher coverage warranted)

credit_drivers.data_source: Audited financial statements, DSCR calculation

credit_drivers.name: Days Cash on Hand
credit_drivers.description: Liquid reserves / daily operating expenses
credit_drivers.data_source: Balance sheet, statement of cash flows

credit_drivers.name: Regulatory Licensing & Compliance
credit_drivers.description: State health department licensing status; deficiencies, citations, enforcement
credit_drivers.context: Behavioral health facilities face increasing regulatory scrutiny post-COVID (higher incident rates)
credit_drivers.monitoring: State health department records, regulatory filings, licensing board meetings
credit_drivers.data_source: State health department, licensing board records, regulatory filings

leverage_framework.definition: Debt-to-Capitalization = Total Debt / (Total Debt + Unrestricted Net Assets)

data_sources: Moody's Investor Service (rating reports, default studies)
S&P Global Ratings (credit analysis, rating publications)
Hospital discharge data (CMS, state health departments)
Medicaid agency publications (reimbursement rates, policy changes)
